title: Prom and Mixtape
author: August Voss
blurb: Felix Vasquez, a debate champion who can't win the argument at home, is fine. Everything is fine. Obviously.. Then the teacher pairs nemesis with nemesis for a semester-long project — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must save the tradition that made the town before graduation.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
